mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where RSAFS increases over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% & CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to concerns about economic contraction.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% QoQ.
